content.title: How do I watch March Madness on TBS online? Here’s where to stream
content.text: If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation. By Joey Chandler | NJ.com March Madness is officially underway, which means college basketball fans are once again asking: Where can I stream TBS? Watch games on TBS for 24 hours with a Sling Orange Day Pass for $4.99 The best bang for your buck to watch all the tournament action on TBS — including the national championship game on April 6 — is Sling TV . Men’s March Madness games will air across four networks: CBS, TBS, TNT and truTV . Both TBS and TNT are available with Sling Orange, but those looking to also watch truTV broadcasts will also need the Entertainment Extra add-on. Watch TBS, TNT and truTV for 24 hours with a Sling Day Pass + Entertainment Extra for $5.99 (truTV is not available with a regular Sling Orange Day Pass) Sling also offers three-day, seven-day and monthly passes. You can get the Sling 3-Day Pass + Entertainment Extra for $11.99 and the Sling Week Pass + Entertainment Extra for $17.99. You can find all of the Sling subscription options from Day Pass to 3-Month Prepay here . For the 3-Day Pass (also called Weekend Pass) and 7-Day Pass (also called Week Pass) you will need to manually add the Sling Entertainment Extra at checkout. It will appear as a pop up toward the top of your browser, select “add Sports Extra,” then click edit and scroll through the add-on options until you see the Entertainment Extra add-on and select that option (as Sports Extra is a different add on). TruTV is not in the Sling Sports Extra, but in the Entertainment Extra, which is why you’d opt for that add-on extra for your day, 3-Day Pass or Week Pass. Sling Blue and Sling Orange + Blue both also carry TBS and TNT in their channel lineup. You can get half off the Sling Orange + Blue plan during your first month for $32.50. Sling, however, does not carry CBS, which you will also need access to for select games. Thankfully, you can get a Paramount+ Premium plan for just $2.99 your first two months to watch every tournament game on CBS. (Live sports are not available with the Paramount+ Essential plan). You can also watch March Madness games for free with a five-day trial to DirecTV . Where to watch each round Here’s a breakdown of what channel each round of the men’s 2026 March Madness tournament will be streaming on: First and second rounds are on CBS, TBS, TNT and truTV Sweet 16 and Elite Eight games are on CBS and TBS. The Final Four and championship game are broadcast on TBS.
